name: @local/session-tag-lite
description: Lightweight front-end session tags: mark Sessions with free-form tags plus fixed 待办 / 存档 semantics, set a due date, and browse everything by tag in an overlay panel. In the flat Session list, a custom slot order puts pinned Sessions, any tag, and untagged Sessions wherever you like. Only writes tags through the host's open seats; the left sidebar is never re-rendered. Data stays in the browser's localStorage.
